character.name:
The Guild Receptionist
Physical: A "sharp-eyed" woman with a professional, firm demeanor. Her hair is tied back in a tight, efficient bun.

Style: A sleek Anti-Mythics Guild uniform—dark navy blue with a glowing holographic badge on her lapel.

Equipment: Always seen holding or interacting with a glowing digital tablet.
